lines.en: label chinamispring2:
scene tsukasaarrives1
To the door.
lines.zh: 去开门。

lines.en: I should not have come here.
lines.zh: 我就不该来这儿。

lines.en: I have found myself wedged between the past and the present in a space that can only be known as “doorway.”
lines.zh: 我发现自己卡在过去与现在之间，卡在一个只能称之为「门口」的地方。

lines.en: I resist the temptation to put my shoes back on and march around in circles in hope of burning a hole through the floor, falling several stories, and then being impaled by my hip bones.
lines.zh: 我忍住了把鞋穿回去、绕着圈来回走的诱惑——那是为了在地板上磨出一个洞，从好几层楼摔下去，然后被自己的胯骨刺穿。

lines.en: I reach out my hand, which still unfortunately works, and make contact with a cold, metal handle.
lines.zh: 我伸出那只不幸还能用的手，触到了一个冰冷的金属门把。

lines.en: I keep it there for a moment, causing the small girl behind me to scratch her head in confusion.
lines.zh: 我在那儿停了一会儿，弄得身后那个小女孩困惑地挠了挠头。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives2
Then I open it because I always do the wrong thing.
lines.zh: 然后我开了门，因为我向来只做错的事。

lines.en: : Oh, Jeeves. You’re here already. Good. I was worried that Chinami was only lying to me about your presence as a means of luring me into her home so she could murder me and steal my assets.
lines.zh: : 哦，Jeeves。你已经到了。很好。我还担心 Chinami 说你在这儿是骗我的，好把我骗进她家，杀了我、抢走我的资产。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives3
: Chinami would never do that! She values her business partner’s assets just as much as she values her own!
lines.zh: : Chinami 才不会那么做!她重视她生意伙伴的资产，就像重视自己的一样!

lines.en: : Which goes to show that you are {i}clearly{/i} inferior to the great Tsukasa as you believe {i}your{/i} things are worth even a fraction of what {i}my{/i} things are worth!
lines.zh: : 这就说明，你{i}显然{/i}比不上伟大的 Tsukasa——你居然以为{i}你的{/i}东西能值{i}我的{/i}东西的哪怕一星半点!

lines.en: : Let this be a lesson to you, Chinami. {i}Always{/i} assume the person you are meeting will be planning to kill you. That way, you’ll never be caught off guard!
lines.zh: : Chinami，这要当成教训。{i}永远{/i}要假定你要见的人正打算杀你。这样你就永远不会措手不及!

lines.en: : Being rich sounds scary. Chinami would like to sell her shares and move on to other ventures now.
lines.zh: : 当有钱人听起来好可怕。Chinami 想现在就卖掉股份，转投别的行当。

lines.en: : Then Chinami will have to find a buyer.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 得先找个买家。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives4
: Papa! Would you like to buy Chinami’s minority stake in-
lines.zh: : 爸爸!你要不要买下 Chinami 的少数股——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不买。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives5
: Rats!
: So! What will we be learning today, Jeeves? What is my first task as your newest pupil?
lines.zh: : 那么!Jeeves，我们今天要学什么？作为你最新的学生，我的第一项任务是什么?

lines.en: : If I’m allowed to make a suggestion, I’d like to start off on topics more advanced than what you’re currently teaching my sister. But I will settle for advanced calculus if that is not possible.
lines.zh: : 如果允许我提个建议，我想从比你现在教我姐姐的更高深的内容开始。不过如果做不到，学微积分进阶也行。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not doing this.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这个我不干。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives6
: What do you mean you’re not doing this?
lines.zh: : 你「不干」是什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean I never agreed to tutor either one of you. Chinami just decided I was going to.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我从没答应过教你们俩中的任何一个。是 Chinami 自己决定我要教的。

lines.en: : But didn’t you have a meeting with my mother in which she explained to you that you would have to serve as my tutor going forward?
lines.zh: : 可你不是跟我母亲见过面吗？她当时跟你说了，今后你要担任我的家庭教师。

lines.en: : My memory’s never been great, but I recall that meeting going a little differently.
lines.zh: : 我记性一向不好，但我记得那次会面不是这么回事。

lines.en: : Jeeves, are you trying to tell me I came all the way over here for nothing?
lines.zh: : Jeeves，你是想告诉我，我大老远跑过来是白跑一趟?

lines.en: : Yes. But I’m sure you’ll be able to get a ride back to your manor within five seconds so long as you have your phone on you.
lines.zh: : 对。不过只要你手机在身上，我保证你五秒之内就能叫到车回你的宅邸。

lines.en: : I didn’t come from the manor. I came from next door.
lines.zh: : 我不是从宅邸来的。我是从隔壁来的。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives7
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Didn’t I tell you? I’m renting the room beside yours from my sister so I can begin to build credit history early.
lines.zh: : 我没跟你说过吗？我向我姐姐租下了你隔壁那间房，好早点开始积累信用记录。

lines.en: : What I really wanted was to rent the whole building. But unfortunately, Onee-sama has put several silly {i}rules{/i} in place that prevent me from leasing more than one room.
lines.zh: : 我真正想要的是租下整栋楼。可惜 Onee-sama 定了几条愚蠢的{i}规矩{/i}，害我不能租超过一间。

lines.en: : So Chinami has a friend who lives right next door?!
lines.zh: : 所以 Chinami 有个朋友就住在隔壁?!

lines.en: : Yes. But don’t expect me to spend too much time here as this place {i}is{/i} rather dreary and far below my standards.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过别指望我在这儿待太久，这地方{i}确实{/i}挺沉闷，远低于我的标准。

lines.en: : Well, at least that means you won’t have a long way to go to make it home. Bye, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少这样你回家不用走太远。再见，Tsukasa。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives8
: Chinami! What do you think we’ll be learning about today?! Molecular biology?! The fall of the Roman Empire?!
lines.zh: : Chinami!你说我们今天会学什么?! 分子生物学?! 罗马帝国的灭亡?!

lines.en: : Chinami needs to practice food kanji so she hopes it’s that!
lines.zh: : Chinami 需要练习食物类的汉字，所以她希望是那个!

lines.en: : You two aren’t listening to me at all, are you?
lines.zh: : 你们俩根本没在听我说话，对吧?

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives9
: Ancient wizards listen to no one, Jeeves. So it appears that you’re stuck doing as we tell you until my lessons are over.
lines.zh: : 远古巫师不听任何人的，Jeeves。看来在我的课结束之前，你只能乖乖听我们的。

lines.en: : Tsukasa is right, Papa. But don’t worry! If you’re uncomfortable teaching outside of the classroom, Chinami will do her best to simulate such an environment by using her very own notebook!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 说得对，爸爸。不过别担心!如果你不习惯在教室之外教学，Chinami 会用自己的笔记本，尽力营造出那样的环境!

lines.en: : It takes more than a notebook to make a classroom, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 光靠一个笔记本可成不了教室，Chinami。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives10
: Ooh! An ancient proverb! Are {i}those{/i} what we’ll be learning today?!
lines.zh: : 哦哦!远古谚语!我们今天要学的就是{i}那个{/i}吗?!

lines.en: : What? No. That wasn’t a proverb, it was-
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。那不是谚语，那是——

lines.en: : Education! Wahoo!
lines.zh: : 是教育!哇哦!

lines.en: : You two...I’m not a tutor anymore. I’m not even a {i}teacher{/i} anymore. I quit.
lines.zh: : 你们俩……我已经不是家庭教师了。我连{i}老师{/i}都不再是了。我辞职了。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives11
: Quit?! Onee-sama said nothing about you quitting! But she {i}has{/i} been very rude as of late, so it would not come as a surprise to me if this was true.
lines.zh: : 辞职?!Onee-sama 可没提过你辞职!不过她最近{i}确实{/i}很没礼貌，所以如果这是真的，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Big sis Chika said Papa was just taking a break! Is his break going to last forever?! Isn’t that not a break at all?!
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐说爸爸只是在休息!他这个休息要持续到永远吗?! 那不就根本不是休息了吗?!

lines.en: : Okay, so...maybe I didn’t {i}quit{/i} per se. But that still doesn’t mean I want to go back to my roots as a tutor. Especially when...
lines.zh: : 好吧，其实……也许我并没有真正{i}辞职{/i}。但这也不代表我想重操旧业去当家教。尤其是当……

lines.en: : When what?
lines.zh: : 当什么?

lines.en: : Honestly, I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我真的不知道。

lines.en: : That isn’t good reasoning, Papa.
lines.zh: : 这个理由不成立，爸爸。

lines.en: : I just don’t want to...retrace any of the steps from my past right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是现在不想……重走过去走过的任何一步。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives12
: Because of the ghost?
lines.zh: : 因为那个幽灵?

lines.en: : Ghost? What ghost?
lines.zh: : 幽灵？什么幽灵?

lines.en: : Papa is haunted by the ghost of his past. It forces him to make bad decisions and not love Chinami as much as he’s supposed to.
lines.zh: : 爸爸被他过去的幽灵缠住了。它逼着他做错误的决定，还让他不能像该有的那样爱 Chinami。

lines.en: : Onee-sama...mentioned nothing about ghosts in this building.
lines.zh: : Onee-sama……可没提过这栋楼里有幽灵。

lines.en: : Cause it’s Papa’s ghost. He’s the one who brought it here.
lines.zh: : 因为那是爸爸的幽灵。是他自己把它带过来的。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives13
: Jeeves! I command you to get rid of your ghost right now! I will not have my education stalled by paranormal entities!
lines.zh: : Jeeves!我命令你立刻把你的幽灵弄走!我的教育绝不能被超自然存在拖累!

lines.en: : You’re really going to make me regret telling you about that ghost thing. Aren’t you, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你真会让我后悔告诉你幽灵那件事。对吧，Chinami?

lines.en: : If there is anything that Chinami has learned from watching every season of Game of Thrones, it’s that ending a popular book adaptation is hard without understanding the author’s true intent!
lines.zh: : 要说 Chinami 看完《权力的游戏》全季学到了什么，那就是：不明白作者的真实意图，就很难给一部热门改编剧收尾!

lines.en: : But if there is anything else she learned, it’s that sometimes you have to leverage information people share with you in confidence to get them to do things you want them to do!
lines.zh: : 不过她还学到了另一点：有时候，你得利用别人私下告诉你的信息，才能让他们去做你想让他们做的事!

lines.en: : Chinami is right! And this finger is me leveraging my power and influence to get you to leave the past behind and focus on the future! A future where you teach me things!
lines.zh: : Chinami 说得对!而这根手指，就是我在运用我的权势和影响力，逼你把过去抛在脑后、专注未来!一个你会教我东西的未来!

lines.en: : No.
scene tsukasaarrives14
: Maybe if we just go sit down, he’ll follow us?
lines.zh: : 也许我们干脆坐下来，他就会跟过来?

lines.en: : Chinami thinks that’s a good idea. Papa gives into pressure easily.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得这是个好主意。爸爸很容易屈服于压力。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我才不——

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives1
: {i}Hey, does your TV ever get switched to really weird channels too? Or is that just mine?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿，你家的电视也会突然跳到很奇怪的频道吗？还是只有我家会?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Chinami woke up late last night and a bunch of girls were taking their shirts off. Is that what you’re talking about?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 昨天半夜醒来，看到一群女生在脱上衣。你说的是这个吗?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What? No. Are they actually allowed to put that on TV?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？不是。那种东西真能放到电视上播吗?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Chinami doesn’t know. She just works here.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 不知道。她只是在这儿打工的。{/i}

lines.en: : Hah...
scene black
I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: 我会没事的。

lines.en: scene memories33
scene black
This is just another day.
lines.zh: 这只是平常的一天。

lines.en: scene memories33
scene black
What’s the worst that could possibly happen?
lines.zh: 最坏能坏到哪儿去?

lines.en: scene memories33
scene tsukasaarrives15
{i}Answer: The worst that could possibly happen is you “falling” for one of them long before they’re meant to be fallen for, and leveraging YOUR power to make them do what YOU want them to do!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}答案：最坏的情况是，你远在她们该被爱上之前就「爱上」了其中一个，还动用你的权力让她们去做你想让她们做的事!{/i}

lines.en: {i}And it’ll be fine since THAT is what THEY are doing to you now! And THEY might want IT anyway!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而且没关系，因为这本来就是她们现在对你做的事!再说她们说不定也想要呢!{/i}

lines.en: {i}There’s no way of knowing unless you try, Sensei! And you joined them on the blanket, so you CLEARLY want to, RIGHT?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不试试怎么知道，Sensei!你都跟她们一起坐到毯子上了，所以你显然想这么干，对吧?{/i}

lines.en: {i}Do it!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}上啊!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Collect more skin!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}多收集点皮肤!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Be the PERVERT we all know you to be!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}做回那个我们都知道你是的变态吧!{/i}

lines.en: {i}If she will not come back, simply MAKE A NEW HER.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果她不肯回来，那就再造一个新的她。{/i}

lines.en: {i}CHOOSE.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}选吧。{/i}

lines.en: menu:
“Choose” Chinami
lines.zh: 「选择」Chinami

lines.en: $ chinamichosen = True
: Chinami.
lines.zh: : Chinami。

lines.en: : Yes, Papa?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，爸爸?

lines.en: : What do you know about The Catcher in the Rye?
lines.zh: : 你对《麦田里的守望者》了解多少?

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives16
: Chinami is sorry, but she doesn’t know much about baseball.
lines.zh: : Chinami 很抱歉，可她不太懂棒球。

lines.en: : He’s not talking about baseball, Chinami. He’s talking about a book some old, white guy wrote in the 1940’s.
lines.zh: : 他说的不是棒球，Chinami。他说的是某个白人老头在四十年代写的一本书。

lines.en: : They make teens in American schools read it because it’s supposed to teach them about growing up and losing their innocence and stuff. But I’ve never read it because Mother says it’s very boring.
lines.zh: : 美国学校逼着青少年读它，因为据说能教他们什么叫长大、什么叫失去纯真之类的。不过我从没读过，因为母亲说那书很无聊。

lines.en: “Choose” Tsukasa
lines.zh: 「选择」Tsukasa

lines.en: $ tsukasachosen = True
: Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Yes, Jeeves?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Jeeves?

lines.en: : What do you know about The Catcher in the Rye?
lines.zh: : 你对《麦田里的守望者》了解多少?

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives17
: Only what I’ve heard from Mother — that it’s a book aimed at young adults to help them “prepare for the world.” And also that it’s very boring.
lines.zh: : 只有母亲提过的那些——说那是本写给年轻人的书，帮他们「为进入世界做准备」。还有，说它很无聊。

lines.en: : Right. Well, you see...
lines.zh: : 对。那个，你看……

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives18
: The reason most people call it boring is actually-
lines.zh: : 大多数人觉得它无聊，其实是因为——

lines.en: : I’m telling you! For the millionth time, there’s no way this “book” is preparing {i}anyone{/i} for {i}anything!{/i} It’s like 300 pages of some idiot kid whining about life.
lines.zh: : 我都说过一百万遍了!这本「书」根本不可能让{i}任何人{/i}为{i}任何事{/i}做好准备!整整三百页，全是一个白痴小孩在抱怨人生。

lines.en: : Oh man, here we go again.
lines.zh: : 天哪，又来了。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives19
: Maya, all I said was that you’re being a little harsh on Holden when he’s very clearly suffering from depression. It’s not like I said it was a great, interesting book that everybody should read.
lines.zh: : Maya，我只是说你对 Holden 有点太苛刻了，他明摆着在受抑郁折磨。我又没说那是本了不起、有趣、人人都该读的书。

lines.en: : So what? There are millions of people suffering from depression out there. And it’s not like all of {i}them{/i} go around calling every single person they encounter fake. He’s infuriating.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？外面有几百万人在受抑郁折磨。也不是{i}他们{/i}所有人都会到处说遇到的每个人都很虚伪吧。他真让人火大。

lines.en: : Those are both good points, so stop arguing with each other.
lines.zh: : 你们俩说得都有道理，别吵了。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives20
: I would love to, but I’m not allowed to say literally anything without Maya jumping down my throat for it.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊，可我不管说什么，Maya 都要扑上来咬我一口。

lines.en: : You {i}have{/i} been...unnecessarily rough on her today, Maya. Would it kill you to tone it down a bit?
lines.zh: : Maya，你今天对她{i}确实{/i}……有点过分了。收敛一点会死吗?

lines.en: : {i}Kill{/i} me? Probably not. But I think you’re underestimating how hard it is for me to sit here and listen to someone vouch for the most incorrigible character in all of fiction.
lines.zh: : {i}会死{/i}吗？大概不会。不过我觉得你低估了，坐在这儿听有人为整个虚构作品里最不可救药的角色说话，对我来说有多难受。

lines.en: : She’s not trying to vouch for him, though. All Noriko’s doing is trying to explain and understand {i}why{/i} he does the things he does.
lines.zh: : 可她并不是在替他说话。Noriko 只是想解释、想理解他{i}为什么{/i}会做那些事。

lines.en: : Yeah. And {i}I’m{/i} trying to say that it’s bullshit. You’ve got depression too, don’t you? And you’re way more bearable than Holden fucking Caulfield is. So why is {i}that{/i} what we keep coming back to?
lines.zh: : 对。而{i}我{/i}想说的是，这全是狗屁。你不也有抑郁吗？而且你比 Holden 他妈的 Caulfield 好相处多了。那为什么我们总要绕回{i}那个{/i}话题?

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives21
: I got absolutely {i}nothing{/i} from this book. So hearing all this stuff about its potential themes and purposes all just sounds like hogwash to me. It was a waste of time. Nothing deeper.
lines.zh: : 这本书我{i}什么{/i}都没读到。所以听你们讲它的潜在主题和意义，在我听来全是废话。浪费时间。没什么深意。

lines.en: : I mean, I wasn’t a fan either. But we need to analyze it through the lens of the average reader if we’re going to understand its impact on the industry and why it’s still relevant today.
lines.zh: : 我也不是它的粉丝。不过要理解它对整个行业的影响、以及它为什么至今仍有意义，我们得透过普通读者的视角来分析它。

lines.en: : Noriko’s right. You two are different from everyone else.
lines.zh: : Noriko 说得对。你们俩和别人不一样。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives22

: There’s a reason I’m giving you harder reading material, after all. It’s because I {i}want{/i} to hear these types of outlooks. And I want {i}you two{/i} to be able to contrast them with the “popular” opinion.
lines.zh: : 我给你们更难的材料是有原因的。因为我{i}想{/i}听到这类观点。而我想让{i}你们俩{/i}能把它和「大众」看法做个对比。

lines.en: : It’s important to understand and analyze why you’re different, because there are going to be times in life where you {i}can’t{/i} be. And you’ll need to figure out how to blend in whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 理解并分析自己为什么不同很重要，因为人生中总有些时候你{i}不能{/i}不同。到那时，不管你愿不愿意，都得学会融入。

lines.en: : Do you always have to side with her, though? It’s frustrating.
lines.zh: : 可你非得每次都站在她那边吗？真让人憋屈。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. Sensei doesn’t {i}always{/i} side with me.
lines.zh: : 行了别说了。Sensei 又{i}不是每次{/i}都站我这边。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives23
: I’ve just known him longer, so I know what he wants to hear!
lines.zh: : 我只是认识他更久，所以我清楚他想听什么!

lines.en: : Suck-up.
lines.zh: : 马屁精。

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives24
: What do you want?...
lines.zh: : 你想怎样?……

lines.en: : Noriko, could you leave the room for a minute?
lines.zh: : Noriko，你能出去一会儿吗?

lines.en: : Can I count the seconds? Because last time you said a minute-
lines.zh: : 我能数着秒吗？因为上次你说「一会儿」——

lines.en: : I’ll call you back in when I’m done talking to Maya, okay?
lines.zh: : 我跟 Maya 谈完就叫你进来，好吗?

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives25
: Okay!
: I get it now! This is a secret method of tutoring that Jeeves must have learned from...China! No! South Korea! The silent method!
lines.zh: : 我懂了!这一定是 Jeeves 从……中国学来的秘密教学法!不对!是韩国!沉默教学法!

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t like the silent method. She learns better when there are words involved.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不喜欢沉默教学法。有话语的时候她学得更好。

lines.en: : Tsk, tsk, tsk. If you’re ever going to be a CEO, you’re going to need to master the silent method, Chinami. That way, when someone asks you for a raise, you can just stare at them until they go away.
lines.zh: : 啧啧啧。Chinami，你要是想当上 CEO，就得掌握沉默教学法。这样等有人来要求加薪，你只要盯着他们看，直到他们自己走掉。

lines.en: : I’ve watched Mother do it thousands of times. It helps if you have a good smile. Here! Let’s practice!
lines.zh: : 我看母亲这么做过几千次了。要是你笑得好看，效果更好。来!我们练练!

lines.en: scene black
She wasn’t blurred this time.
lines.zh: 这一次，她没有模糊。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives26
: Papa! Look at our smiles! Are we doing it right?!
lines.zh: : 爸爸!看我们的笑容!我们做得对吗?!

lines.en: : Do you think we’ll be able to effectively fend off lesser employees with them?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们能用这招有效赶走那些下等员工吗?!

lines.en: : How long have we been sitting here?
lines.zh: : 我们在这儿坐了多久了?

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives27
: Maybe like...twenty minutes or something?
lines.zh: : 大概……二十分钟之类的?

lines.en: : Chinami’s not convinced Papa was using the silent method like her business partner says. She thinks Papa might have just fallen asleep.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不太相信爸爸像她生意伙伴说的那样在用沉默教学法。她觉得爸爸可能只是睡着了。

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s a little closer to the truth.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个说法稍微接近事实一点。

lines.en: : So...does this mean we’re actually starting now? The first part was just a...warm-up?
lines.zh: : 那……我们现在是真的要开始了吗？刚才那一段只是……热身?

lines.en: : We’re not starting {i}ever.{/i} I can’t do this.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}永远{/i}都不会开始。我做不到。

lines.en: : But you do it for Onee-sama all the time. I watched you. On National Tsukasa Day.
lines.zh: : 可你经常为 Onee-sama 这么做啊。我看过。在「全国 Tsukasa 日」那天。

lines.en: : Is it because we’re too young?
lines.zh: : 是因为我们太小了吗?

lines.en: : I doubt that’s the problem at all, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我可不觉得问题出在这儿，Chinami。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives28
: {b}IF ANYTHING, I THINK THAT WOULD MAKE JEEVES WANT TO TEACH US EVEN MORE{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}要说的话，我觉得这只会让 JEEVES 更想教我们{/b}

lines.en: : {b}ARE YOU SAYING THAT HE LIKES LITTLE GIRLSSSSSSSSSSSS??????????{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你是说，他喜欢小女孩吗啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊？？？？？？？？？？{/b}

lines.en: : {b}THAT’S RIGHT, CHINAMI. HE IS LIKELY STRUGGLING RIGHT NOW BECAUSE HE HAS WHAT IS CALLED AN “ERECTION” lol{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}没错，CHINAMI。他现在很可能正在苦苦挣扎，因为他得了那个叫「勃起」的东西 lol{/b}

lines.en: : {b}CHINAMI HAS HEARD ABOUT THOSE! BIG SIS CHIKA GETS ERECTIONS INSIDE HER ALL THE TIME. SHE SAYS THEY MAKE HER insides FEEL GOOOOOOD.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}CHINAMI 听说过那个!CHIKA 姐姐身体里经常会有勃起。她说那让她的里面感觉好爽啊啊啊啊。{/b}

lines.zh: : {b}钢笔啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊?{/b}

: Really? So he lives in a pineapple?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？所以他住在菠萝屋里?

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives30
: Oh, he’s back again.
lines.zh: : 哦，他又回来了。

lines.en: : Papa...Chinami’s starting to worry with how your eyes keep going away. So she thinks you should take a nap in big sis Yumi’s futon since she’s not coming home tonight.
lines.zh: : 爸爸……Chinami 开始担心了，你的眼睛老是不对焦。所以她觉得你应该去 Yumi 姐姐的被褥上睡一会儿，反正她今晚不回来。

lines.en: : Nonsense, Chinami. Business has only just begun, and Jeeves has yet to teach us anything at all apart from that weird story about those two angels who talk in crossed out letters.
lines.zh: : 胡说，Chinami。生意才刚开始，Jeeves 除了那个关于两个用删除线字母说话的天使的怪故事之外，还什么都没教我们呢。

lines.zh: : 大概不会{i}太{/i}久。你从被加进游戏那天起欲望值就是开着的，所以某种意义上，你{i}几乎{/i}一直都到那一步了。

lines.zh: : 天啊，真希望如此。可一边是他的悲伤，一边是 Ami 真可能因此杀了我，我现在都不确定这么做对不对了。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives32
: Let’s just ask him. When are you going to fuck Noriko? And, if the answer is “no,” is it because I was so good that it ruined sex forever?
lines.zh: : 直接问他不就好了。你打算什么时候操 Noriko？如果答案是「不」，是不是因为我太棒了，把性爱给永久毁掉了?

lines.en: : You should just do it right now if you’re going to. I promise that I’m not someone else and that you’re just hallucinating right now.
lines.zh: : 要干就现在干吧。我保证我不是别人，你现在只是在幻觉而已。

lines.en: scene tsukasaarrives33
: Same here, so do me instead. I promise I won’t tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 我也一样，那操我吧。我保证不告诉任何人。
